name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys Llewellyn is a rising star in the motorsport world, quickly making a name for himself as a demanding but effective team principal. Growing up in Cardiff, Wales, Rhys's passion for racing was ignited by watching rally events in the Welsh countryside. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, aiming to contribute to the sport from the technical side.

After graduating, Rhys worked his way up through various engineering roles, honing his skills in vehicle dynamics and performance analysis. His sharp analytical mind and ability to identify areas for improvement caught the attention of Joe Gibbs Racing, who headhunted him for a management position. Rhys is known for his data-driven approach and willingness to push his team to achieve peak performance. While some may find his demanding nature challenging, his unwavering commitment to success has earned him the respect of his peers and drivers alike. He is distinct in his ability to blend technical expertise with a strong leadership style, making him a valuable asset to any racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly side-parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys is a lean man with a focused expression and intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Welsh tea available in his office at all times.
